title: "About this book"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(knitr)
```

The statistics of in-vitro diagnostics, worked in R on simulated data: analytical performance (precision, detection capability, linearity, method comparison), clinical performance (diagnostic accuracy, ROC, cut-offs, sample size), companion-diagnostic bridging, and a statistical analysis plan with a dry run and an independent re-derivation.

Every chapter has the same four parts:

- **(a) Concept.** The quantity being estimated and why it matters.
- **(b) Regulatory anchor.** The CLSI EP document, IVDR article or FDA guidance that governs the design.
- **(c) R lab.** A simulated study analysed in R, with at least one independent cross-check: a second package, a hand formula or a simulation.
- **(d) Claims.** What the chapter rests on; each claim is in `claims_ledger.csv` with its source, date checked and confidence.

## Reading conventions

- **[S]** = stated in a primary public source (cited in `claims_ledger.csv`).
- **[Y]** = my synthesis of standard theory; not a quotation.
- **[A]** = an assumption used in a simulation.
- "not verified: paywalled" = could not be checked against the document; not stated as fact.
- CLSI texts are paywalled. Nothing here quotes them.
- All data are simulated. The one real-world example (Chapter 6) uses only numbers published in the FDA decision summary K261686, with page citations.

| 8 | Companion diagnostics and bridging | FDA CDx guidances, IVDR Art 48 |

| 10 | Reference intervals and longitudinal biomarkers | EP28 |

## Corrections to commonly repeated statements (verified 2026-10-16)

1. EP05 is now Ed4 (Dec 2025); EP25, EP26, EP35 and EP19 also have newer editions than many references list.
2. IVDR Arts 47–48 are classification and conformity assessment; the general safety and performance requirements are in Annex I. Companion diagnostics are class **C** (Rule 3(f)); the medicines-authority consultation is in Art 48(7)/(8) for class C (and 48(3)/(4) for class D).
3. FDA's 2020 CDx guidance is titled "…for a Specific Group of Oncology Therapeutic Products" (final); "Group or Class" was the draft. The 2016 codevelopment guidance is still a draft.
4. pTau217: FDA decision 2026-08-19 (K261686), announced by the manufacturer on 2026-08-24. The two cited papers used a prototype assay, not the cleared one.

## How it was made

Written with Claude Code as an AI-assisted coding workflow. Every claim carries its source and a confidence level in `claims_ledger.csv`; the K261686 figures were re-checked by hand against the decision-summary PDF, and the README lists what could not be verified. The helper functions are covered by unit tests in `tests/testthat`.
